ListenRoom.title: ListenRoom
ListenRoom.description: Real-time Play Bersama (Listen Together) synchronized playback room with collaborative queue, live chat, and vote skip, identified by a 6-character room code.

hostUid.description: Authenticated Firebase UID of the room host (immutable after create).

hostName.description: Display name of the room host.

status.description: Lifecycle status of the room. Once ended, no further mutations are permitted.

guestsCanControl.description: Whether joined participants can control playback directly.

memberUids.description: Bounded list (1..25) of authenticated Firebase UIDs currently in this room.

memberNames.description: Bounded parallel list (1..25) of display labels formatted as uid|name for active listeners.

currentTrackId.description: YouTube video ID or track identifier currently synchronized.

currentTrackTitle.description: Title of the currently synchronized track.

currentTrackArtist.description: Artist name of the currently synchronized track.

currentTrackAlbum.description: Album name of the currently synchronized track.

currentTrackArtwork.description: Artwork URL of the currently synchronized track.

playing.description: Whether synchronized playback is currently playing.

positionMs.description: Last synced playback position in milliseconds.

syncSequence.description: Monotonic sequence counter incremented on every playback/queue sync event.

queueTracks.description: Bounded list (0..30) of collaborative upcoming track maps in the room, including upvote UIDs.

chatMessages.description: Optional bounded list (0..40) of live chat message maps in the room.

skipVoteUids.description: Optional bounded list (0..25) of member UIDs currently voting to skip the active track.

lastActionBy.description: Short activity message describing the latest room event.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp (FieldValue.serverTimestamp()) when the room was created.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp (FieldValue.serverTimestamp()) of the most recent update.

RecentRoomEntry.title: RecentRoomEntry
RecentRoomEntry.description: User-private history of Play Bersama rooms created or joined.

userId.description: Owner Firebase UID matching path userId.

CloudLibrarySnapshot.title: CloudLibrarySnapshot
CloudLibrarySnapshot.description: User-private cloud backup snapshot of liked tracks and custom playlists synchronized across devices.

userId.description: Owner Firebase UID matching path userId.

payloadJson.description: Serialized JSON backup containing liked tracks and custom playlists.

likedCount.description: Total liked tracks in the cloud snapshot.

playlistCount.description: Total custom playlists in the cloud snapshot.

deviceLabel.description: Human-friendly device model name that uploaded this snapshot.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp (FieldValue.serverTimestamp()) when the snapshot was first created.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp (FieldValue.serverTimestamp()) of the most recent sync.

/listen_rooms/{roomCode}.description: Real-time Play Bersama rooms keyed by 6-character alphanumeric room codes.

/users/{userId}/recent_rooms/{roomCode}.description: User-scoped private list of recently created or joined Play Bersama rooms.

/users/{userId}/library_sync/{docId}.description: User-scoped private cloud library snapshot (docId == 'snapshot') storing synced favorites and playlists.
